description.narrative: The Government has the evidence, resources and technical knowledge necessary to revise and implement health sector policy and deliver more inclusive, integrated and quality health and nutrition services, including through food systems, especially in vulnerable communities, before and during public health crises. This activity contributed to sublevel results - Life saving interventions,Immunization and wild polio eradication,HIV treatment and care interventions,Prevention of stunting and other forms of malnutrition,Safely managed drinking water, sanitation and hygiene
